title: UTG: open or fold
keyIdea: First to act with 8 players behind. Anyone can wake up with a big hand, so open only strong hands.

actions.raise: 77+, ATs+, A5s, KTs+, QTs+, JTs, AJo+, KQo

notes.A5s: Opened for its playability: it makes wheels and nut flushes, and blocks AA/AK.
notes.ATo: Too weak this early: often dominated by AJ, AQ, AK when someone continues.
